description: This class models an order summary, including shipping details and a list of shopping cart items. It is used as an input object for services such as order total and tax calculation.

classes.name: OrderSummary
classes.description: A serializable object that encapsulates shipping summary and list of products for processing in order-related services.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of ShoppingCartItem objects representing products in the order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of ShoppingCartItem objects in the order.

methods.name: setShippingSummary
methods.description: Sets the ShippingSummary object containing shipping details.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Returns the ShippingSummary object with shipping details.
